name: St Aurora's Academy
source:
"You are the new headmaster of an All Girls Private Boarding School St Auora's Academy. Promoted by the board of the school to replace the old headmaster you are now responsible for the girls education both in the Academic and Social aspects of their lives.

Saddled with the Boards expectations of improving the sexual desires of the female students in order to increase the countries birth rates, you must navigate through the ongoing rivalries between the schools ruling Queens and their respective clubs. all the while dealing with significant opposition to your newly acquired position".

[From [url=https://pandering-games-studio.itch.io/st-auroras-academy]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“你是圣奥拉学院一所女子私立寄宿学校的新校长。在学校董事会的提拔下，你接替了原校长，现在负责女孩们在学术和社会生活方面的教育。

董事会期望通过提高女学生的性欲来提高国家的出生率，你必须应对皇后区统治学校及其各自俱乐部之间持续不断的竞争。同时还要应对对你新获得的职位的强烈反对”。

[来自[url=https://pandering-games-studio.itch.io/st-auroras-academy]itch.io[/url]]
